item.title: Contradictory road marking/signage, 15th September
item.description:
This stretch of road looks to have double yellow lines all the way up but there's a sign that says no waiting Mon to Saturday, implying you can park on Sundays. Looking at the TRO, only park of the road should be double yellows and the rest a single line with a waiting restriction. I don't want to get ticketed if I park on a Sunday!

item.title: Traffic lights not sensing traffic correctly, 15th September
item.description:
The traffic lights at the junction of Christchurch Road and Queens Road are no longer sensing traffic correctly, and seem to be on a fixed timing schedule. Previously (about a month ago) they responded rapidly to approaching vehicle/cycles and would adjust accordingly, but in the last few weeks the timing seems to be independent of the traffic approaching.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Christchurch Road, Warden Hill, Cheltenham, Cheltenham
Report on FixMyStreet

item.title: Sewage smells outside house, 15th September
item.description:
The drains are our road are not blocked. They have been looked at. There is a sewage smell outside our house (on the driveway of no 20) and along Nightjar Rd. I have spoken to Severn Trent numerous times and they say it is not their issue (due to not having adopted the drains yet). They say it lies further away, with the new development across Mill Lane or the new school as all of the waste from there comes down our road. The issue has been present for 3 years now (every summer as the weather warms up). I don’t know how to get this investigated further. Please advise me.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): Nightjar Road, Tewkesbury
Report on FixMyStreet
